_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
U mpiri {player_id} eka michezo ya LinesOfAction.
Swifaniso swa wena i '{side}', swifaniso swa muphikisi i '{other}'.
Muundo wa ku famba: `[b1b3]` (khwara ya ku suka ku ya khwara). Ku famba kwa ndlela ya milawu ku famba kwa ushikilele, kwembu, kumbe diagonal ku famba idlala ya makhwara ya swifaniso (makhadi yoyote ya rangi) eka ndlela yoleyo. U nga fambi swifaniso swa wena, kambe u nga fambi swifaniso swa muphikisi; ku wela eka muphikisi ku mu dlaya.  U wini loko swifaniso swa wena swote swi hlanganile.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomete yi fanele ku va e2e4 (ku suka eka, kuya eka tikhorodini).
invalid_move.identical: Laha yi humaka kona ni laha yi yaka kona swa fana.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Ku famba ku fanele ku va hi ndlela leyi kongomeke kumbe ya le matlhelo.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Yi fanele yi famba mpfhuka lowu ringanaka ni swiphemu leswi nga etlhelo ka yona.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Swihontlovila swa valala swi pfale ndlela.
invalid_move.destination_own: Ndhawu leyi a yi tirhisiwa hi munhu un'we.

game_action.captured_suffix: Muteri {player_id} u hume {from} -> {to} a ku nyika muntshwa wa ripfumelo.

outcome.draw_no_capture: Ku hundze 60 wa mintshamo ku nga si va ni nhlaselo.
